texts.preamble: Dinesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 17 August, 2021 Author: Pankaj Bhatia Bench: Pankaj Bhatia High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 6 Case :- Writ - A No. - 8985 of 2021 Petitioner :- Dinesh Kumar Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Rajesh Yadav
texts.arguments: Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C. Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J. The present writ petition, inter alia, has been filed for the following relief: "a. to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Mandamus commanding the respondents to decide the application/representation of the petitioner in the light of Government Order dated 17.04.2009 (Annexure No. 01 to this writ petition), forthwith and/or to pass any such other and further order, which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case." The contention of the counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner was appointed under the dying-in-harness rules. The State Government for effective implementation of Drug and Cosmetic Rules and Prevention of Food Adulteration Act proposed creation of a separate department i.e. Khandya Evam Aushadhi Prashasan Nideshalaya and segregated the same from the parent department i.e. Medical and Health Department. The contention of the counsel for the petitioner is that the petitioner was transferred on 20.2.2010. Since then, the petitioner has been working there, however, he has not be absorbed in the due department and this regard, the petitioner filed a representation, which is pending consideration. Learned Standing Counsel has pointed out that the petitioner earlier had approached this Court by means of a Writ Petition No. 21122 of 2017 wherein an order was passed on 31.5.2017 for considering the grievance of the petitioner. The petitioner, however, states that the representation was filed before the wrong person and as such, the petitioner has approached this Court.
